title: What You Hate Isn't Management — It's Being Asked to Pretend
title_zh: 你讨厌的不是管理，是被要求假装
excerpt: What people resist isn't being managed — it's being asked to perform a role they don't believe in.
excerpt_zh: 人们抵触的从来不是被管理，而是被要求扮演一个自己都不相信的角色。

title: When You Say "Don't," the Model Hears "Do"
title_zh: 你说「不要」，模型听到的是「要」
excerpt: From Dostoevsky's polar bear to BERT's blind spot: why 'not' is the hardest word for any information-processing system to execute.
excerpt_zh: 从陀思妥耶夫斯基的北极熊到 BERT 的盲区：为什么「不」这个字是任何信息处理系统都最难执行的。

title: Cognitive Precocity: Why Some People Have Profound Insight So Young
title_zh: 认知早熟：为什么有的人可以很年轻就有很深刻的认知
excerpt: It's not talent or luck. Cognitive depth = information density × feedback frequency × pattern recognition — and which dimension you optimize matters most.
excerpt_zh: 不是天赋，也不是运气。认知深度 = 信息密度 × 反馈频率 × 模式识别——而你优化的是哪个维度最重要。

title: How I Distilled a Writing Skill from yage.ai
title_zh: 我从 yage.ai 的文章里「蒸馏」出了一个写作 skill
excerpt: I fed every article from yage.ai into Opus 4.6 and asked it to find structural patterns. Then I turned those patterns into an executable writing skill.
excerpt_zh: 把 yage.ai 的所有文章丢给 Opus 4.6 找结构共性，再蒸馏成一个可执行的写作 skill。三轮 prompt，从分析到产出。

title: Hello World: My First Post
title_zh: 你好世界：我的第一篇文章
excerpt: Welcome to my new blog built with pure HTML and Markdown.
excerpt_zh: 欢迎来到我用纯 HTML 和 Markdown 搭建的新博客。

title: Let ChatGPT Help Merge Your Code
title_zh: 让 ChatGPT 帮你合并代码
excerpt: How to use ChatGPT to automate code merging workflows.
excerpt_zh: 如何用 ChatGPT 自动化代码合并流程。

title: Prompt Engineering: A Practical Guide
excerpt: Master the art of writing effective prompts for large language models.
excerpt_zh: 掌握为大语言模型编写有效提示词的技巧。

title: Running LLMs Locally: A Complete Guide
title_zh: 本地运行大模型完全指南
excerpt: How to run open-source LLMs on your own machine with Ollama, llama.cpp and more.
excerpt_zh: 如何用 Ollama、llama.cpp 等工具在自己的电脑上运行开源大模型。

title: When Plagiarism Costs Nothing, 'Original' Loses Its Meaning
title_zh: 当洗稿成本归零，「原创」就失去了定义
excerpt: AI rewrites can replicate 80% of an article's value while scoring 100% on originality checks. What happens when our definition of 'original' breaks down?
excerpt_zh: AI 改写可以零成本获取文章 80% 的价值，同时在检测系统眼中拥有 100% 的「原创性」。当「原创」的定义失效，我们该信任谁？
